title: Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning for Backdoor Removal
abstract: arXiv:2611.33571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a severe threat to modern NLP models by embedding hidden triggers that induce malicious behavior at inference time. Recent unlearning methods such as gradient ascent (GA) attempt to remove backdoors by maximizing the loss on poisoned samples; however, these methods can suffer from a critical limitation: they may shift the trigger's influence to other classes rather than eliminating it. In this work, we propose Trigger-Invariant Contrastive Unlearning (TICU), a framework for mitigating textual backdoor behavior by enforcing prediction and representation invariance to trigger insertion. TICU constructs clean and trigger-inserted counterfactual pairs, then fine-tunes the model so that both inputs produce consistent output distributions and aligned hidden representations. translated_title: 面向后门移除的触发器不变对比遗忘
translated_abstract: 后门攻击对现代NLP模型构成严重威胁，其通过嵌入隐藏触发器在推理阶段引发恶意行为。近期的遗忘方法（如梯度上升法GA）试图通过最大化中毒样本的损失来移除后门；然而，这类方法存在一个关键局限：它们可能将触发器的影响转移到其他类别，而非真正将其消除。在本工作中，我们提出了触发器不变对比遗忘，这是一个通过强制模型对触发器插入具有预测和表示不变性来缓解文本后门行为的框架。TICU构建干净样本与插入触发器的反事实样本对，然后对模型进行微调，使两类输入产生一致的输出分布和对齐的隐藏表示。为了保持干净任务上的性能，TICU还在干净数据上保留监督分类损失，并约束参数相对原始模型的漂移。
tldr: 提出TICU框架，通过构建干净与插入触发器的反事实样本对并强制预测与表示对触发器插入保持不变性，有效移除NLP模型中的文本后门，同时借助干净数据监督损失和参数漂移约束维持干净任务性能。
